notes.title: 17/08/23, Minor Patch
notes.content:
-Made all NPC Voices equal in volume
-Can no longer go offscreen 
-Cant softlock when going right in hospital or going left in any indoors space
-Minor Dialogue changes
-Changed the Mayors Speech
-Dialled back on some of the wavy text
-Removed public webhooks due to a certain someone
-Report bugs button
-Inventory now saves
-Added the Town Hall in granola
